words.definition_en: the crime of stealing something

words.definition_en: deliberate destruction of property

words.definition_en: wrongful deception intended to result in financial gain

words.definition_en: a dishonest scheme to trick people out of money

words.definition_en: the crime of stealing someone's personal information to commit fraud
example_sentences: Identity theft has increased with online banking.

words.definition_en: phrasal verb: to enter a building illegally by force

words.definition_en: an illegal forced entry into a building

words.definition_en: to take someone into custody by legal authority

words.definition_en: a person believed to have committed a crime

words.definition_en: proof that someone was elsewhere when a crime happened

words.definition_en: to carry out research to establish facts about a crime

words.definition_en: an official examination of the facts of a crime

words.definition_en: money paid to allow release from custody before trial

words.definition_en: held by the police, especially before or during trial

words.definition_en: phrasal verb: to avoid punishment for a wrongdoing

words.definition_en: a local scheme where residents watch out for suspicious activity

words.definition_en: closed-circuit television used for surveillance

words.definition_en: news being reported as it happens
